sentences.text:
1  THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF  CR.P.C. PRAYING TO SET ASIDE THE ORDER DATED 18.06.2022 AND  06.10.2022 IN SPL.S.C.NO.101/2021 ON THE FILE OF THE  ADDITIONAL SESSIONS JUDGE FTSC-I AT CHIKKABALLAPURA.
 -2-  CRL.P No. 53 of 2023  THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ADMISSION,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER This petition filed by the petitioner/accused No.2 under section 482 of Cr.P.C for setting aside the order of the trial court for dismissing the application filed by the petitioner under section 311 of Cr.P.C in Special.S.C.No.101/2021 for recalling the PWs.2, 9 and 10.
2.
Learned HCGP takes notice for the State.

3. Heard the arguments of learned HCGP and learned counsel for petitioner .
4.

The case of the petitioner is that petitioner is facing the trial for the alleged for the offence punishable under Sections 376 (2)(n) and 5 & 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner is said to be in custody and the prosecution examined the witnesses and the counsel for the accused, cross examined the witnesses but due to change of counsel and the earlier counsel was appointed through Legal Services Authority and not properly cross examined these witnesses.
Therefore the petitioner wants to cross examine PWs.2, 9 , 10 and 12 for the purpose of further cross examination which came to be rejected hence he is before this court.

5. Having heard the argument and perused the records, which reveals of course the petitioner facing the trial of serious offences punishable under the POCSO Act as well as 376 (AB) of IPC where the victim girl aged about 9 years below 12 years.

The counsel for the petitioner submits though the PWs.2, 9, 10 and 12 cross examined by the earlier counsel, who was appointed through the Legal Services authority but not cross examined properly and now the accused counsel appeared and filed application for recalling witnesses.

Of course the fair trial is guaranteed under Article 21 of Constitution of India, but the victim is aged about 9 years and as per the provisions of section 33 (5)
of POCSO Act, the victim girl cannot be frequently called to the court for the purpose of examination or testifying

, however, the document deposition produced by the learned counsel and submission of learned counsel reveals the PW2 victim girl has been cross examined extensively and completed the cross examination.
Therefore in view of the bar under section 33 (5) of the POCSO Act, the victim girl aged about 9 years is considered as child cannot be recalled frequently for the purpose of testifying.

sentences.text: However, the PW9 who is the complainant and PW.12 is head constable who received the complaint and PW.10 the doctor who examined the victim.

Therefore, I am of the view that the petitioner shall be given an opportunity for further cross examination of PWs.9, 10 and 12,
considering the same, the petition deserves to be allowed.
Accordingly, petition is allowed in part.
The impugned order passed for PWs.9, 10, 12 is hereby set aside.
Rejection of application under Section 311 Cr.P.C for recalling the PW2 is hereby confirmed.
The application for recalling PWs.9, 10 and 12 is allowed.
The trial court is directed to secure the presence of the PWs.9, 10 and 12 for the purpose of further cross examination by the counsel.

The counsel for the accused shall not seek any adjournment when the witnesses are present, if the witnesses are present before the Court and for any adjournment sought by the accused counsel, then the trial court is at liberty to impose heavy cost.
